summary: Environment A evidence for adding a text search box to the Intelligence Feed, composing with its existing domain filter chips - the third Phase 6 (Operator Ergonomics) slice.
auditFinding: IntelligenceFeed.tsx renders the full cross-domain, 50-item-capped feed with domain filter chips already present, but had no text search at all. The 'S' keyboard shortcut's searchInputRef is a completely unrelated pre-existing feature (Manual Bible Search), not reusable here. See docs/phase-6-3-audit.md.
designChoice: No genuine architectural fork this phase (unlike 6.2's confirm/undo split) - one clear shape, so implementation proceeded directly without an operator design question: a new pure filter function following the established filterBooksByPrefix precedent, composed with the existing domain filter.

newCode.intelligenceFeedTs: apps/desktop/src/lib/intelligenceFeed.ts: searchIntelligenceFeed(items, query) - case-insensitive substring match against summary/detailLine, null-safe, empty query returns items unchanged.
newCode.intelligenceFeedTsx: apps/desktop/src/components/workspace/IntelligenceFeed.tsx: new text input composed with the existing domain filter chips over the same already-fetched items array; empty-state message generalized to cover either filter being active.

intelligenceFeedTestTs: matches a mid-string word in the summary, case-insensitively
matches against detailLine when summary doesn't match
never throws on an item with a null detailLine
trims whitespace from the query before matching
returns every item unchanged for an empty or whitespace-only query
returns an empty list when nothing matches, never guessing a fallback

fullRegression.lint: npm run lint: same pre-existing warnings as before this phase - no new ones
fullRegression.rustChanges: None - zero Rust files touched this phase, confirmed via git status/diff, so no Rust regression re-run was needed.

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new database schema changes.
Pure client-side filter over data already fetched for the existing feed - no new fetch, no change to the 50-item cap (MAX_VISIBLE_INTELLIGENCE_ITEMS in lib/unifiedFeed.ts).
The panel remains read-only, per its own existing doc comment - search never becomes a second action surface.
Composes with (does not replace) the existing domain filter chips.
